compatibilityPolicy.sameApiVersion: Host updates preserve source and binary compatibility for documented public contracts unless a security correction requires an announced exception.
compatibilityPolicy.newOptionalMembers: New interface capabilities use optional interfaces or default interface members where possible.
compatibilityPolicy.breakingChanges: Breaking contract or manifest changes require a new apiVersion and plugin rebuild.
compatibilityPolicy.hostRange: The package manifest minimumHostVersion and optional maximumHostVersionExclusive are authoritative for installation.
